integrity.proof_scope: An explicit exact recurrence for every nonnegative integer height, and a convergent entropy series with a strict comparison inequality.

scientific_limitations: Only initial primitive period three; no entrance-time or other-period census.
Historical novelty is qualified by incomplete indexing of older work.
Finite checks are not a replacement for the symbolic all-height proof.
title: Branching entropy and exact primitive-three excitation counts on binary trees of triangles
